answer: Two escalation steps (Tier 1 Support → Tier 2 Support) occur before the ticket reaches Platform Engineering, and the required acknowledgment time stays the same at each step—each must acknowledge the ticket within 30 minutes, regardless of tier [1].

Platinum $2,499 15 minutes 1 business hour Email, Chat, Phone, Dedicated Slack
"Critical" severity means a total outage or a security-impacting defect with no workaround. "Normal"
severity covers all other requests, including questions and minor bugs.
4. Escalation Process
If a ticket is not resolved within its tier's response window, it is automatically escalated through the
following path: Tier 1 Support -> Tier 2 Support (specialist engineer) -> Platform Engineering on-call -> VP
of Engineering. Each escalation step must acknowledge the ticket within 30 minutes of receiving it,
